notes: Large-source-unit לְהַרְבֵּה מְאֹד → 'exceeding' reviewed and retained: the fixed doubled intensifier is rendered by one English degree word that carries the sense of both הַרְבֵּה and מְאֹד, so rule 30 fuses rather than leaving הַרְבֵּה unrepresented beside its own sense; head on מְאֹד whose lexeme 'exceeding' writes most directly. Competing reading (מְאֹד alone, לְ and הַרְבֵּה unrepresented) is named in the unit note.
Distributive עִיר וָעִיר: כֹּל takes 'every', first עִיר rendered, waw and second עִיר unrepresented (rules 15, 22).
